AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Introduction to Aviation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Aviation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Aviation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Aviation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Aviation.

2. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Isometric Drawing.

3. When learning Safety in the Aviation Workplace, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety in the Aviation Workplace.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety in the Aviation Workplace.

   D. Skip safety briefings for Safety in the Aviation Workplace.

5. When learning Introduction to Aviation 1.2 Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Aviation 1.2 Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Aviation 1.2 Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Aviation 1.2 Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Aviation 1.2 Safety in the Aviation Workplace 1.3 Airport Safety.

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

7. When learning Aircraft Components, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Components.

   B. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Weather 3.2 Aviation Communication 3.3 Aerodynamics of Flight 4.0 Airpo.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Weather 3.2 Aviation Communication 3.3 Aerodynamics of Flight 4.0 Airpo.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Weather 3.2 Aviation Communication 3.3 Aerodynamics of Flight 4.0 Airpo.

   A. Skip safety briefings for Airport Safety 2.0 Aircraft Basic Construction 2.1 Aircraft Components 2.2 Aircr.

   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Ignore burnt cables

12. When learning Airport Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airport Safety.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airport Safety.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Airport Safety.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airport Safety.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
